task: Generate and compare two original black-and-white representation territories for the Starlight Character Foundry v2.
surface: Founder territory-selection boards and character-system documentation
audience: Starlight founder, character designers, runtime owners, and independent visual reviewers
first_read: The same five responsibilities become either human civic operators or non-humanoid living instruments, without superhero, robot, or cosmic defaults.

references.label: Starlight Character Foundry v2
references.reason: Defines bounded intelligence, the black-and-white territory gate, required stress-test roles, and originality boundaries.

references.label: SIS taste constitution
references.reason: Requires founder territory selection and rejects cosmic, robot, black-glass, cyan, gold, and command-center defaults.

references.label: Marvel visual method research
references.reason: Contributes transferable story readability and production discipline without copied expression.

keep: Five identical role functions across both boards
Visible instruments, limits, handoffs, and evidence
Human warmth in Territory A and ownable mechanism in Territory B
avoid: Superhero costumes, robots, cosmic imagery, thrones, and militarism
Generated labels, interface copy, logos, and all-caps text
direction.signature: Bounded intelligence becomes visible as a separable relationship between a responsible person and an inspectable instrument.
system: Territory A recommended for public character representation
Territory B recommended for instruments, diagrams, registry marks, and motion behavior
Graphite, ink, charcoal, warm paper, honest material, and grayscale hierarchy
Orchestrator, Sentinel, Concierge, Weaver, and Starlight Sage shown in the same sequence

asset_quality.why_premium: Both boards are custom, strongly art-directed, original, high-resolution, visually inspected, structurally comparable, and specific to the Foundry's role and trust grammar.

artifacts.notes: Inspected at original 1536 by 1024 resolution and inline preview. Strong human warmth and role readability; shared workwear and tiny pseudo-marks require correction in final character sheets. SHA-256: 912728e326df9d3a34b25bc68461ba415034696fc98444ca288781bcd7ae7b67.

Inspected at original 1536 by 1024 resolution and inline preview. Highly ownable mechanism and silhouette system; emotional distance and repeated plinths prevent recommendation as the sole public character class. SHA-256: c0c91d4c8e2dca89efb8eec94e1242074482215d2a5d674a9cb6bb4fd722ef25.

checks.name: asset-tier
checks.evidence: Tier B custom generated media with stored prompts, versions, hashes, and inspection evidence.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: Both final v2 PNG files were reopened from their project paths and inspected at original resolution.

checks.name: visual-qa
checks.evidence: Checked first read, grayscale hierarchy, silhouette separation, anatomy, geometry, role correspondence, materials, composition, and artifact risks.

checks.name: role-collision
checks.evidence: Both boards show the same five functions in the same order; Concierge, Sentinel, and Weaver satisfy the required stress test.

checks.name: text-and-casing
checks.evidence: No interface copy, headings, labels, logos, or all-caps text are rendered in either image. Minor nonsemantic pseudo-marks are recorded as a future exact-overlay risk.

checks.name: rights-and-originality
checks.evidence: No Marvel character, logo, costume, trade dress, named-artist style, or recognizable franchise expression appears in the final boards.

score.notes: Strong enough for founder territory selection. Not approved for character canon, public campaign use, or fleet fanout until founder and G0 gates pass.

known_risks: Territory A could develop workwear and instrument-frame sameness across a large cast.
Territory B could become emotionally distant and over-institutional at fleet scale.
Generated pseudo-marks must never be treated as exact information; production labels require deterministic overlays.
No color, mobile crop, animation, or live product-context test is authorized before the founder territory verdict.
